status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; 415 tests passed; Quest APK audited; physical headset acceptance pending

installation.headsetInteractionAcceptance: Pending user worn-headset test of canonical poses, retained hold, proportional lever and material AA

pico: Shared source updated; no 0.2.17 PICO APK built in this iteration

visual_review.scope: Actual SDK skinned hands and production tools, synthetic inputs. Left/right pairs for all 11 grasp kinds.

material_aa.context: Editor GPU render, 480x320, 1x samples to isolate shader aliasing, fixed time, 3 mm camera shift, distant water crop; not headset performance

limits: Headset comfort, occluded optical tracking and frame timing require worn-device testing.
Display contact uses part OBB proxies; authored display joints never feed physical input.
Creek pull-pump mechanic remains unchanged; proportional travel applies to the well lever and its empty outlet.

input_contract.supersedes: The automatic open-hand park and dual-open drop in 0.2.15/0.2.16 are replaced by retained ownership. Rack-open return and explicit return operations remain.
input_contract.hold: A held tool follows the valid owner palm even at zero closure. Tracking loss freezes it and cancels actions. Full opening cancels charge but arms the next deliberate squeeze.
input_contract.return: Move away from rack, then back within 0.18 m, touch rack volume and fully open owner hand for 0.35 seconds.
input_contract.canonical_frames: Physical palm and displayed grip share fixed per-hand contact offsets. Nozzle has transverse wrap; body/support and wheel rim no longer choose arbitrary surface normals.
input_contract.material_aa: 4x MSAA retained. Derivative-based procedural filtering for creek/moss/glints, silhouette widths and wet normal variance.
